messages:
Priya R: quick check — livestream next Sat 03:00-09:00 UTC, need standby capacity in apac (asia-southeast1). target: 12 A100-equiv GPUs for peak 6h. Can vendor hold standby & confirm invoice timing? worried about double billing across reserved month boundary.
Ethan V: pinged vendor; expecting terms. vendor said can hold up to 8 nodes as 'standby' for 6h with a refundable hold fee (5% of expected usage). needs PO by Fri 20:00 UTC or it auto-releases. will confirm invoicing lag.
Maya K: can we burst rest to hosted API? latency SLO for livestream is <150ms 95pct. if hosted fallback meets that we can reserve fewer dedicated nodes.
Samir P: FYI dedicated pool quotas in asia-southeast1 show 4 free A100s right now.
Li Chen: billing note — to avoid double-billing make sure to tag resources with billing tag `standby:livestream-mar`. Finance confirmed we can code hold fee to 'standby_holds' GL account if approved.
InfraBot: automated capacity snapshot: asia-southeast1 -> A100_free:4, spot_avail:14, reserved_alloc:120 (snapshot 1769995450)
Priya R: ok — action items: 1) @Ethan V confirm PO terms & invoice lag 2) @Finance approve hold fee to standby_holds 3) @Maya validate hosted fallback latency under load 4) @Samir / @Li run quick terraform & billing tag changes
Ethan V: will DM procurement now. vendor asked for PO number format `PO-RW-<env>-<date>`; also asked for tentative start time in PO.
Maya K: I'll run a small generator load test tonight against hosted endpoints and post p95 numbers.
Samir P: quick terraform snippet to bump igroup (if we go hybrid): `resource "google_compute_region_instance_group_manager" "livestream" { target_size = 6 }` — can revert after.
Li Chen: I can apply billing tags once infra has the project and instance names. please reply with project id.
Priya R: Project is `redwood-livestream-apac`. Ethan / Finance please confirm by EOD Thu.
Ethan V: vendor confirmed invoicing is net30 but will issue proforma on hold. will attach hold fee on proforma. sending PO draft in #procurement.
Priya R: perfect. if any blocker call out asap. :thumbsup:
Maya K: noted, will post latency numbers before EOD.
InfraBot: reminder: PO deadline Fri 20:00 UTC (automated alert)
Priya R: thanks all — locking plan: reserve 8 standby nodes from vendor + 4 from dedicated pool; hosted burst fallback enabled. closing thread unless new info.
Ethan V: acknowledged.
Samir P: will stand by for TF PR.
Li Chen: ready to tag once PR merged.
